data.name: ResponderCorrelationIdUnsupported
data.value: Receive channel step '{0}' declares a correlationId on a request/reply (responder) step; request/reply correlation is handled by the transport, so a step-level correlationId applies only to plain receive steps.

data.name: ResponderNoRequestBody
data.value: Request/reply receive step '{0}' has no requestBody; a responder step must declare the reply payload to send back.

data.name: ResponderReplyValueUnresolvable
data.value: Request/reply receive step '{0}' has a reply value '{1}' that cannot be resolved; a responder reply may reference only $message, $inputs, and $steps.

data.name: UnsupportedReplyPayloadKind

data.name: ReceiveCriterionForbiddenReference

data.name: NoValueForRequiredParameter
data.value: Step provides no value for required parameter '{0}' of operation '{1}'.

data.name: UnsupportedRequestBodyBaseKind
data.value: Request body kind '{0}' is not supported as a base for payload replacements.

data.name: UnresolvableArgumentValueKind
data.value: Argument value kind '{0}' cannot be resolved to a JSON element.

data.name: StepMissingStepId
data.value: A step is missing its required stepId.

data.name: FireAndForgetSuccessCriteria
data.value: Channel step '{0}' has success criteria on a fire-and-forget send step; only receive and request/reply channel steps support success criteria (against $message.*).

data.name: CorrelationIdNotReceiveStep
data.value: Channel step '{0}' declares a correlationId but is not a receive step; per the Arazzo specification correlationId applies only to AsyncAPI steps with action 'receive'.

data.name: CorrelationIdOnRequestReply
data.value: Channel step '{0}' declares a correlationId on a request/reply (responder) step; request/reply correlation is handled by the transport, so a step-level correlationId applies only to plain receive steps.

data.name: CorrelationIdNotDefined
data.value: Channel step '{0}' declares correlationId '{1}', but the channel's message defines no correlation id of that name (it must be in-sync with a correlationId defined in the AsyncAPI document).

data.name: UnsupportedCorrelationLocation
data.value: Channel step '{0}' correlationId '{1}' has location '{2}'; only $message.payload#/… and $message.header#/… correlation locations are supported.

data.name: UnsupportedStepTarget
data.value: Step '{0}' targets {1}; only operation, sub-workflow, and channel steps are supported by the current generator.

data.name: ChannelSourceNoProtocol
data.value: Channel source '{0}' declares no servers[].protocol; a channel source document must name its transport protocol (ADR 0051) so the host can bind the broker transport.
